Each rider has a simple straight practical lance with a small cyan plasma tip, no serrated blades, and restrained equipment. Preserve only the small existing bronze princely bident-and-cross markings from rider reference 2. No new elaborate emblems. Broad daylight and soft clouds, distant rocky ridges and a small outpost; subtle ground dust, visible legs and feet, calm military patrol composition, cinematic realistic 3D render, wide 3:2. Focus on faithful horse shape and rider-to-horse proportions, not explosions.
